title: Vigil
subtitle: Securing the Future
text:
If damage would be dealt to another friendly unit, prevent 1 of that damage.
If damage would be dealt to this unit by another card, deal that much damage plus 1 instead.
Plot
rules:
If the other friendly unit has a Shield attached, you can choose in what order to resolve the prevention effects.
Vigil's ability applies to a single instance of damage once; after increasing or decreasing the total damage dealt by 1, Vigil's ability does not resolve again.
